messages:
Olivia (Finance): FYI we just got a dispute (DB-8610) for txn txn_2098 - cardholder claims multiple unauthorized micro-charges and wants full refund. Amounts are small but repeated.
Raj (Payments): Pulling the auth traces now. Merchant m-302 shows 7 micro-auths over 12 hours. Looks like stored credentials used. Any merchant proof of recurring consent?
Olivia (Finance): Merchant notes in portal: customer accepted T&Cs on checkout, but merchant didn't attach signed mandate. Billing descriptor shows 'vendor-co SUBS'.
Dana (Risk Ops): Flag: BIN country (card) != shipping country. Also device risk score high and same vault token vid_zz used at m-302 and m-77. Cross-merchant token reuse + BIN mismatch -> high fraud signal. Recommend temporary billing hold.
Leo (Support): Customer convo: they say they never subscribed and only noticed charges after an email they ignored. They opened a support ticket on 2024-10-04. I added a note and offered provisional refund pending payments.
billing-bot: New dispute DB-8610 created and routed to team_payments. Link: https://internal.redwood/cases/DB-8610
Raj (Payments): Got auth logs: 3DS not triggered (ECI=79), AVS partial match, CVV present. Gateway shows tokenization partner used server-side tokenization (merchant posted PAN in initial request).
Dana (Risk Ops): If merchant posted PAN to partner, liability likely with merchant. But token vid_zz being reused across merchants is suspicious - could be token replay by a compromised PSP.
Olivia (Finance): We need: merchant's subscription consent proof (checkout receipts), recurring mandate if available, tokenization partner contract proving PCI scope, and delivery/consumption evidence (if service). If not, advise merchant settle.
Raj (Payments): I'll request: 1) full gateway trace, 2) partner tokenization logs, 3) merchant's consent screen screenshots, 4) backend order logs. ETA 4 hours.
Leo (Support): I'll ask customer to forward any emails they received and confirm last4. Will keep refund offer on hold per payments guidance.
Dana (Risk Ops): Also suggest contacting partner security about vid_zz pattern. Escalate to compliance if partner lacks attestation.
Olivia (Finance): Note: multiple micro-charges increase dispute ratio for m-302. If liability falls to merchant, we still need remediation plan from them to avoid reserve increase.
Raj (Payments): Update: merchant provided screenshot showing checkbox consent, but timestamp is after first charge. Merchant claims a bug retroactively set consent flag. Suspicious.
Dana (Risk Ops): That weakens their case. Prepare representment but include tokenization partner logs to shift liability. Also prepare a timeline: first auth, consent timestamp, token creation.
billing-bot: Evidence checklist updated for DB-8610: gateway_trace, consent_screens, token_logs, customer_emails.
Raj (Payments): I'll assemble representment. If partner shows server-side PAN upload, we push for merchant liability. If partner shows client tokenization, we may need to split liability.
Olivia (Finance): Good. Keep reserves informed and estimate potential chargeback loss (~$65 total). If we end up losing representment, we'll absorb and flag merchant for remediation.
Leo (Support): Customer accepted provisional refund offer if representment fails. Noted.
Dana (Risk Ops): Scheduling quick sync with partner security now. Will update thread after call.
Raj (Payments): Representment draft in 6h, attaching docs. Will cc finance and risk.
Olivia (Finance): Thanks team. Let's aim to close DB-8610 this week.
